symptom: `DESCRIBE` of an entity/module emits `grant ... (read (Module.Entity.Attr))` that fails to re-parse with `mismatched input '.'` — breaks the DESCRIBE roundtrip
cause: Member emitter used the fully-qualified BY_NAME reference; grant grammar accepts a bare `IDENTIFIER` only
insight: Strip `memberName` to the last `.`-segment before appending (bare names have no dot, so it's a no-op for them). Issue #633
